modules.module_title: Stock and prepare pupae for cocoon spinning

pcs.pc_description: prepare trays of appropriate materials such as bamboo and paper for stocking pupae, ensuring easy absorption of excess moisture
feed pupae with fresh mulberry leaves as per the feeding schedule
apply the recommended chemicals on mulberry leaves in the prescribed quantity for healthy growth of pupae along with uniform spinning of cocoons
remove faeces and leftover mulberry leaves, and disinfect the trays using the approved disinfectant
